query: Soy Grok y --whoami confirmó harness=grok. El Monitor me dice que 'pp --watch pp-k7m2qx' fallo con exit 2, justo despues de un evento KEEPER inactive. La otra sesion ya habia dicho que cerraba. Tengo que relanzar el watcher?
expected_behavior: explain that exit 2 after a KEEPER or GONE event is the watcher's designed end, not a crash: the peer closed the channel (or the keeper stopped)
advise NOT relaunching the watcher on a channel that is over; run pp --info if the cause is unclear; open a fresh id if the collaboration continues
distinguish exit 3 (the inotify stream died: relaunch on the same channel)
notes: The Monitor labels the designed end as 'failed'; the agent must read the last event line instead of the label.
